nrc-clifton-nj.assessment: Netherlands Reformed Congregation of Clifton was organized November 26, 1883 and is part of the very conservative Dutch Reformed Gereformeerde Gemeenten federation. NRC is one of the most theologically conservative confessional Reformed bodies, holding the Three Forms of Unity with strong emphasis on experiential/old-paths Reformed piety. Specific pastor name and exact street address need direct verification.
